policy: Only explicitly supported facts belong in structured filters. Empty arrays and unknown mean not established, not unsupported. Public creator statements are source documented; creator confirmed requires a direct attributable correction or confirmation. Community tested requires exact setup and outcome. No outreach message or metadata scan counts as testing.
